t: Imagine This: A Web Without Servers - Tara Vancil - JSConf EU 2018

q.x: 2. This year at JSConf EU 2018 Tara Vancil talked about Beaker ( [link] ) an experimental peer-to-peer browser. This was really fascinating to listen to. Here is Tara's talk: [link]

desc:
The Web was envisioned as an open platform for publishing and sharing information, but that vision has been lost: most people will never publish independently on the Web. What went wrong?

We’ll see how a core facet of the Web platform—setting up and running a server—locks the vast majority of users out of participating in the Web. Finally, we’ll take a look at the peer-to-peer Web, an experiment
